name: Sugar Cane
why: Toyo Enterprise's denim label — post-war American workwear reproduced in Japan on vintage shuttle looms, with sugar cane fibre spun into the cotton.
origin: Toyo Enterprise, founded 1965 clothing US military bases in Japan; when the Vietnam War ended in 1975 it turned domestic and Sugar Cane was born. Sibling labels: Buzz Rickson's, Sun Surf, Whitesville.
opview: The 1947 reproduces the 501XX of that year — 14.25oz on vintage Toyoda shuttle looms, American and Zimbabwean cotton for deliberate yarn irregularity, rope-dyed indigo over a white weft. In the line since 2002.

onething.n: the reproduction that made the house; own-site search, not opened from this environment

notes.murica: American workwear reproduced from Japan — observed with more care than the originals received, and made on looms the Americans discarded. Americana at one remove, which is why it sits at four rather than five.

cities: No own US retail — denim specialists. Self Edge · Franklin & Poe · Statement · Redcast Heritage · Hinoya (Tokyo)
